content.title: About
content.content: The Barbecue Sandwich is a hot sandwich featuring a tender beef steak, smothered in a smoky barbecue sauce, melted cheese, crispy onions and pickles. It belongs to the NFS (New Food Series) line and is designed for quick service in cafés and food courts.

content.title: Interesting Facts
items: The sandwich was first launched in 2023 as part of the NFS range, aimed at modern taste preferences.
The barbecue sauce is made from a proprietary blend of smoked spices and a touch of honey.
Whole‑grain bread is used, retaining its crunch even after heating.
Each sandwich contains 150 g of beef steak, making it more protein‑rich than typical chicken variants.
It is commonly served with fries or a fresh side salad.

items.title: High in protein
items.content: Beef steak provides high‑quality protein essential for muscle repair.

items.title: Source of iron
items.content: Red meat supplies easily absorbable iron, supporting hemoglobin levels.

items.title: Contains zinc
items.content: Zinc from the meat helps maintain a healthy immune system.

items.title: Includes vegetables
items.content: Pickles and onions add vitamin C and antioxidants.

items.title: Energy boost
items.content: The combination of carbs and fats delivers quick energy.

items.title: Gluten allergy
items.content: The bread contains gluten, which may trigger reactions in people with celiac disease.

items.title: High sodium content
items.content: Barbecue sauce and cheese can be salty; individuals with hypertension should limit portions.

items.title: Saturated fat
items.content: Beef and cheese contain saturated fats that can affect cholesterol levels if consumed excessively.

items.title: Food safety risk
items.content: The sandwich should be served hot (at least 75 °C) to prevent bacterial growth.

content.title: How to Eat
content.content: Serve the sandwich hot, straight from the grill. It can be cut in half for easier handling, and optionally topped with fresh lettuce or a drizzle of chili sauce.

content.title: Storage
content.content: Keep the prepared sandwich refrigerated for no more than 2 hours at 4 °C. For longer storage, freeze in an airtight bag for up to 1 month and reheat to an internal temperature of 75 °C before serving.
